messages:
Priya M.: Heads up: deploy-bot held RC-12 after scanner flagged a MEDIUM in imgio/native-decode and an unsigned codec in the bundle. hold until triage.

deploy-bot: [scan-summary] RC-12 -> HOLD\n- vulns: imgio/native-decode: CVE-2026-1234 (MEDIUM, integer overflow)\n- licenses: third_party/fastcodec: signature missing, license: unknown\n- report: /artifacts/rc12/scan/1765432222/report.html

Josh R.: We had a global push planned at 05:00 UTC. Quick mitigation: build a variant without fastcodec and use the reference decoder (slower). Could scope to APAC canary first.

Marta (sec): MEDIUM is exploitable with malformed images but requires specific headers we don't commonly see. I still won't greenlight global rollout. APAC-only internal canary with reference decoder + runtime hardening OK. Add `IMG_DECODE_SANDBOX=1` and reduce concurrent decoders to 2.

Priya M.: Legal, what do you need to allow redistribution vs internal-only canary?

LegalBot: If fastcodec provenance isn't provided, redistribution is blocked. Internal-only canary permitted if artifact removed and manifest shows no unsigned files. Redistribution exception requires provenance or vendor attestation and usually 48-72h.

Josh R.: I'll trigger a shim build (no fastcodec) and push canary packages for APAC only. ETA ~50 minutes. Kicking CI: https://ci.internal/runs/8801

QA Bot: Test plan: smoke, 5k request sample, perf lap. ETA ~35m after artifact is ready. Post results here.

Marta (sec): Also plan to run quick fuzz against decode path on canary nodes for 30m. Post any crash stacktraces.

Priya M.: Action items: 1) Josh - produce shim build by 04:10 UTC. 2) QA - run quick matrix. 3) Marta - sandbox flags confirmation. 4) Legal - standby for manifest review. If QA passes start APAC canary 04:40-06:40 UTC. Rollback criteria: any crash, error rate >0.4%, p99 latency >50% above baseline.

deploy-bot: ops tips:
```
/deploy quarantine rc-12 --reason "scanner hold"
/deploy promote rc12-shim --region apac --canary 3 --by @oncall
```

Josh R.: Build finished, artifact uploaded. manifest: /artifacts/rc12/shim/manifest.json. SHA: sha256:bb22cc33dd44... (truncated). fastcodec not included.

LegalBot: Manifest received. Internal-only canary approved. Redistribution blocked until provenance found.

QA Bot: Quick tests done: error rate 0.01%, p99 +28ms. Recommend canary.

Marta (sec): Fuzz 30m on canary nodes: no crashes so far. Sandbox applied: `IMG_DECODE_SANDBOX=1; MAX_DECODE_THREADS=2`.

Priya M.: Starting APAC canary at 04:43 UTC. Dashboard: https://metrics/release/rc12-apac-canary. Will evaluate at 05:45 UTC.

QA Bot: 60m into canary: stable. error rate 0.02%, p99 +30ms.

Marta (sec): Fuzz results final: no crashes in 30m window.

Priya M.: APAC canary looks good. Holding global rollout pending Legal provenance checks. Recommend staged global at +48h after provenance or earlier if vendor supplies signed attestation. Recording remediation ticket SEC-1512.

LegalBot: I'll continue provenance inquiry with vendor and update thread. To unblock redistribution we need vendor attestation or signed provenance artifact.

Josh R.: Will prepare a rollout plan that requires `--redistribute-allowed` flag for deploy-bot so it won't promote globally until Legal toggles it.

deploy-bot: To unhold globally after legal sign-off run:
`/deploy unhold rc-12 --by @Priya M. --confirm-redistribution`
Rollback: `/deploy rollback rc-11 --reason "canary fail"`

Priya M.: Thanks all. Updating release notes to note temporary shim, perf impact, and legal redistribution hold. Closing hold for APAC canary only. :white_check_mark:
